response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.patsim > 0.439 GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'Missing') ORDER BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'Missing');
